note: strip cell N = @BUILDING def_id N (0-based; cell 0 = Stockade, USER-VERIFIED). EXE draws def_id+1 in EXE-sheet space; the ssdec decode is off-by-one from it so they cancel (spec/ui/colony_screen.md 0.2). Cells are the FULL 56x42 native 1x window (atlas_BUILDING is NOT 2x); the in-window sprite position is the frame's own draw offset, so blit windows at the raw plot (x,y) with no extra +8 (capture-calibrated vs docs/screens/colony_live_1505.png).
